title: Naici Guo
text:
Omics · Biostatistics · Bioinformatics


I am a bioinformatician and statistician with a PhD in Statistics from the University of St Andrews, completed under the supervision of Prof. Andy Lynch and Dr. Giorgos Minas as part of the SMMB research group. I am currently a Postdoctoral Research Associate at the University of Sheffield, working across the Elkhamisi Lab and the Sud Lab.
My research focuses on high-throughput omics data analysis, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics, to understand genome stability, RNA dynamics, and complex diseases such as cancer and neurodegeneration.
I develop statistical and computational methods in Python and R, with interests in Bayesian modelling, machine learning, and AI-driven approaches for biomedical research.
